Subject: Intro: Sable security audit - intake and schedule

Hi Tessa,

I hope youre well. Sable is kicking off a routine vendor security intake ahead of a customer procurement review and wed like to schedule a short intake call with Redwood to go over the SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2 evidence well request.

High level ask:
- 30-45 minute intake call to review questionnaire scope and evidence owners
- Well need a completed CAIQ and the latest SOC 2 summary + any relevant architecture diagrams
- Timeline: ideally initial call this week or early next week, with evidence due within 10 business days after the call.

Ive attached Sable_SIG_Prework_Template.xlsx to capture the items well request. On our side, Asha Mehta will lead and security@sable.ai will be monitoring.

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu 4/23 10:00–10:45
- Thu 4/23 14:00–14:45
- Fri 4/24 09:30–10:15

Can you confirm availability and the right Redwood contacts for evidence (SOC 2, CAIQ, IAM screenshots, logging retention)?

Thanks,
Asha Mehta
Head of Vendor Security | Sable AI
asha.mehta@sable.ai

Attachment: Sable_SIG_Prework_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

- Overall evidence map and owners

- CAIQ completion approach and expected turnaround
- Any environment / IAM / logging screenshots you need -> well note owners and secure transfer method

Internal point people: Hannah (controls + SOC 2) and Marcus (infra + logs/architecture) — looping them in here.

See you on Thu. If you need another time I can shift.

Thanks — Thu 14:00 PST works for us, confirm the calendar invite received.

Pre-call items we uploaded to our portal: https://secure.sable.ai/uploads/caiq/2026-04-21/response-12345.html (this contains our CAIQ baseline and a short questionnaire). On the call well ask for:
- SOC 2 summary + date range and auditor name
- Answered CAIQ sections (we expect about ~60-70% coverage from vendors)
- System architecture diagram (network + data flows) and KMS usage attestation (do you use customer-specific keys or KMS in our region?)
- Evidence transfer: we prefer temporary secure links; if Redwood uses S3 presigned links thats fine (please mark any sensitive items).

Also, please be prepared to confirm log retention windows for API requests and admin audit trails during the intake.

See you shortly,
Asha

- Evidence transfer: agreed to provide password-protected PDFs or presigned S3 links via secure.sable.ai portal. (Tessa)

Open items:
- Marcus to confirm exact KMS key scoping language (customer key vs platform-managed) — flagged for follow-up
- Tessa to share an access matrix template for vendor evidence intake

Next steps: Ill upload the SOC 2 summary and infra diagram to the Sable portal and email the presigned links to security@sable.ai once the files are ready. Thanks again — appreciated the clarity on timelines.
